lines.text: Elisha told the woman and her household to live as foreigners because the LORD had decreed a seven-year famine.
She and her household lived as foreigners for seven years in the land of Moab.
At the end of seven years, the woman returned and appealed to the king for her house and land.
Gehazi told the king how Elisha raised the dead, just as the woman arrived to appeal to him.
The woman confirmed it, and the king appointed a priest to restore all that was hers, with the field's proceeds.
